thesis: The episode argues that while the cryptographic underpinnings of blockchains like Bitcoin and Ethereum have never been hacked, users face significant risks from social engineering attacks and phishing that trick them into revealing private information or signing malicious transactions. Consequently, the transition to Web3 requires a fundamental mindset shift where individuals must directly control and safeguard their own secrets, such as seed phrases, rather than relying on intermediaries to manage their assets.
